This cohort includes males ages 25 - 64

```{r}
# Load cohort
df_cohort = read_rds(file = here::here("data/df_farmworkers_vs_all.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(farmworker_vs_not = if_else(census_occ_code == "6050", "farmworker", "not-farmworker")) %>% 
  filter(recode_age_int >=25 &
         recode_age_int <= 64 &
         recode_sex == 'male')
```

# Education
```{r}
#| output: true
c1_education = df_cohort %>% 
  group_by(farmworker_vs_not, recode_educ_farmwork) %>% 
  summarize(n = n_distinct(id),
            .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(percent_within_occupation = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
         `Number of workers (Percent within occ)` = paste0(format(n, big.mark = ","), 
                                                          " (",
                                                          percent_within_occupation,
                                                          "%)")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-n, -percent_within_occupation) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = farmworker_vs_not,
              values_from = `Number of workers (Percent within occ)`) %>% 
  rename(level = recode_educ_farmwork) %>% 
  mutate(measure = "Highest Level of Education") %>% 
  relocate(measure, level) %>% 
  arrange(level)
  
c1_education %>% 
  dt_table(page = F) 
```

# Age at Death

## Mean
```{r}
#| output: true
c1_age_at_death = df_cohort %>% 
  group_by(farmworker_vs_not) %>% 
  summarize(mean_age_at_death = round(mean(recode_age_int, 
                                      na.rm = T), 1),
            std_age_at_death = round(sd(recode_age_int,
                                  na.rm = T), 1),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(`mean (sd)` = paste0(mean_age_at_death, " (", std_age_at_death, ")")) %>% 
  select(farmworker_vs_not, `mean (sd)`) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = farmworker_vs_not,
              values_from = `mean (sd)`) %>% 
  mutate(measure = "Age at Death",
         level = "Overall") %>% 
  relocate(measure, level) %>% 
  arrange(level)
  
c1_age_at_death %>% 
  dt_table()
```

## Categorical (Large Groups)
```{r}
#| output: true
c1_age_at_death_cat = df_cohort %>% 
  mutate(age_cat = case_when(recode_age_int < 40 ~ "1. <40",
                             recode_age_int >=40 & recode_age_int <=55 ~ "2. 40-55",
                             recode_age_int > 55 & recode_age_int <=64 ~ "3. 56-64",
                             recode_age_int > 64 ~ "4. 65+",
                             is.na(recode_age_int) ~ "5. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE")) %>% 
  group_by(farmworker_vs_not, age_cat) %>% 
  summarize(num_in_category = n_distinct(id),
            .groups = "drop_last") %>% 
  mutate(`percent in category` = as.character(round(num_in_category / sum(num_in_category) * 100, 2))) %>% 
  select(farmworker_vs_not, age_cat, `percent in category`) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = farmworker_vs_not,
              values_from = `percent in category`) %>% 
  mutate(measure = "Age at Death Percentage") %>% 
  rename(level = age_cat) %>% 
  relocate(measure, level) %>% 
  arrange(level)
  
c1_age_at_death_cat %>% 
  dt_table()
```

```{r}
df_ipums = read_rds(here::here("data/df_ipums_limited.rds")) %>% 
        #filter(age >= 25 &
        #       age <= 64) %>%
        filter(labforce == 2) %>% 
        mutate(dplyr::across(.cols = dplyr::everything(),
                       .fns = unclass),
         sex = if_else(sex == 1 , "Male", "Female"),
         age_cat_every_5 = case_when(
                             age < 30 ~ "1. 25 - 29",
                             age <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",
                             age <= 39 ~ "3. 35 - 39",
                             age <= 44 ~ "4. 40 - 44",
                             age <= 49 ~ "5. 45 - 49",
                             age <= 54 ~ "6. 50 - 54",
                             age <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
                             age <= 64 ~ "8. 60 - 64",
                             is.na(age) ~ "9. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE"),
         hispan = case_when(hispan == 0 ~ "Not Hispanic",
                            hispan == 1 ~ "Mexican",
                            hispan == 2 ~ "Puerto Rican",
                            hispan == 3 ~ "Cuban",
                            hispan == 4 ~ "Other",
                            hispan == 9 ~ "Not reported",
                            TRUE ~ "ISSUE"),
         race = case_when(hispan %in% c(1,2,3,4) ~ "Hispanic",
                          race == 1 ~ "White",
                          race == 2 ~ "Black",
                          race == 3 ~ "American Indian / Native American",
                          race %in% c(4,5,6) ~ "Asian / Pacific Islander",
                          TRUE ~ "Other"),
         white_non_white = if_else(race == "White", "White", "Non-White")) %>% 
         filter(sex == 'Male')

```

```{r}
                             recode_age_int <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",

                             recode_age_int <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
```

## Farmworkers (Reference) Vs. Not Farmworkers By Year
```{r}
# group deaths by year, worker/manager, and age category and count the number of 
# deaths in each strata
df_deaths_per_stratum = df_death_ind_stand %>%
  group_by(year.of.death,
           farmworker_vs_not,
           age_cat_every_5) %>% 
  summarize(sum_deaths = n_distinct(id),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  rename(year = year.of.death)
  
# group population by year, worker/manager, and age category and count the number
# of people in each strata
df_people_per_stratum = df_ipums %>% 
  group_by(year,
           farmworker_vs_not,
           age_cat_every_5) %>% 
  summarize(sum_people = sum(perwt, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")
  
# get worker death rates by year and age group by joining to the number of people
# in worker strata and dividing deaths by people
df_worker_death_rates_crude = df_deaths_per_stratum %>%  
  filter(farmworker_vs_not == "farmworker") %>% 
  left_join(df_people_per_stratum,
            by = c("year","farmworker_vs_not", "age_cat_every_5")) %>% 
  mutate(death_rate_crude_worker = sum_deaths / sum_people)

# calculate crude worker death rate overall by year for workers
df_worker_rates_crude_year = df_deaths_per_stratum %>%  
  filter(farmworker_vs_not == "farmworker") %>% 
  left_join(df_people_per_stratum,
            by = c("year","farmworker_vs_not", "age_cat_every_5")) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarize(total_worker_deaths = sum(sum_deaths, na.rm = T),
            total_workers = sum(sum_people, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(worker_crude_death_rate = total_worker_deaths / total_workers)
  
# start with number of people per stratum for not-farmworkers only
# join to get the farmworker death rates per stratum
# calculate expected deaths as number of not-farmworkers times worker death rates per stratum
# join to get actual number of not-farmworker deaths per stratum
df_manager_rates = df_people_per_stratum %>% 
  filter(farmworker_vs_not == "not-farmworker") %>% 
  left_join(df_worker_death_rates_crude %>% 
              select(year, 
                     age_cat_every_5, 
                     death_rate_crude_worker),
            by = c("year", "age_cat_every_5")) %>% 
  mutate(expected_deaths = round(sum_people * death_rate_crude_worker, 2)) %>% 
  left_join(df_deaths_per_stratum %>% 
              filter(farmworker_vs_not == "not-farmworker"),
            by = c("year", "farmworker_vs_not", "age_cat_every_5"))
  
# start with the manager expected and actual death counts by stratum 
# group into years and sum the expected and actual death counts by year
# divide actual by expected to get the adjusted mortality rate by year
# join back to worker crude rates by year 
df_manager_rates_adj_year = df_manager_rates %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarize(total_expected = sum(expected_deaths, na.rm = T),
            total_observed = sum(sum_deaths, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(manager_std_mortality_ratio = round(total_observed / total_expected, 2)) %>% 
  left_join(df_worker_rates_crude_year,
           by = "year") %>% 
  mutate(manager_adj_mortality_rate = manager_std_mortality_ratio * worker_crude_death_rate)
```


```{r}
#| output: true
df_manager_rates_adj_year %>% 
  mutate(worker_crude_death_rate = round(worker_crude_death_rate, 5),
         total_expected = round(total_expected, 2),
         manager_adj_mortality_rate = round(manager_adj_mortality_rate, 5)) %>% 
  relocate(year,
           total_worker_deaths,
           total_workers, 
           worker_crude_death_rate,
           total_expected,
           total_observed,
           manager_std_mortality_ratio,
           manager_adj_mortality_rate) %>% 
  dt_table() %>% 
  add_commas(vars =  c("total_workers",
                        "total_worker_deaths",
                          "total_expected",
  "total_observed"))
```









# Direct Standardization

Using the 2000 census population from [SEER](https://seer.cancer.gov/stdpopulations/stdpop.singleages.html)

[Direct Standardization Example in R](https://www.epirhandbook.com/en/new_pages/standardization.html)

```{r}
df_ipums_direct = read_rds(here::here("data/df_ipums_limited.rds")) %>% 
        filter(age >= 25 &
               age <= 64) %>%
        filter(labforce == 2) %>% 
        mutate(dplyr::across(.cols = dplyr::everything(),
                       .fns = unclass),
         sex = if_else(sex == 1 , "Male", "Female"),
         age_cat_every_5 = case_when(
                             age < 30 ~ "1. 25 - 29",
                             age <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",
                             age <= 39 ~ "3. 35 - 39",
                             age <= 44 ~ "4. 40 - 44",
                             age <= 49 ~ "5. 45 - 49",
                             age <= 54 ~ "6. 50 - 54",
                             age <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
                             age <= 64 ~ "8. 60 - 64",
                             is.na(age) ~ "9. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE"),
         hispan = case_when(hispan == 0 ~ "Not Hispanic",
                            hispan == 1 ~ "Mexican",
                            hispan == 2 ~ "Puerto Rican",
                            hispan == 3 ~ "Cuban",
                            hispan == 4 ~ "Other",
                            hispan == 9 ~ "Not reported",
                            TRUE ~ "ISSUE"),
         race = case_when(hispan %in% c(1,2,3,4) ~ "Hispanic",
                          race == 1 ~ "White",
                          race == 2 ~ "Black",
                          race == 3 ~ "American Indian / Native American",
                          race %in% c(4,5,6) ~ "Asian / Pacific Islander",
                          TRUE ~ "Other"),
         white_non_white = if_else(race == "White", "White", "Non-White"),
         farmworker_vs_not = if_else(occ == "6050", "farmworker", "not-farmworker")) %>% 
         filter(sex == 'Male')
```


### Overall (Year)
```{r}
df_census_2000 = read_csv(here::here("data/census_2000_age.csv")) %>% 
  filter(age >= 25 &
         age <= 64) %>% 
  mutate(age_cat_every_5 = case_when(
                             age < 30 ~ "1. 25 - 29",
                             age <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",
                             age <= 39 ~ "3. 35 - 39",
                             age <= 44 ~ "4. 40 - 44",
                             age <= 49 ~ "5. 45 - 49",
                             age <= 54 ~ "6. 50 - 54",
                             age <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
                             age <= 64 ~ "8. 60 - 64",
                             is.na(age) ~ "9. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE")) %>% 
  group_by(age_cat_every_5) %>% 
  summarize(population = sum(standard_population),
            .groups = "drop")
  
df_deaths_direct = df_cohort %>% 
  rename(year = year.of.death) %>%
  mutate(age_cat_every_5 = case_when(
                             recode_age_int < 30 ~ "1. 25 - 29",
                             recode_age_int <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",
                             recode_age_int <= 39 ~ "3. 35 - 39",
                             recode_age_int <= 44 ~ "4. 40 - 44",
                             recode_age_int <= 49 ~ "5. 45 - 49",
                             recode_age_int <= 54 ~ "6. 50 - 54",
                             recode_age_int <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
                             recode_age_int <= 64 ~ "8. 60 - 64",
                             is.na(recode_age_int) ~ "9. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE"),
        pre_post_covid = if_else(year < 2020, '1. Pre-Covid', '2. Post-Covid')) %>% 
  group_by(year,
           age_cat_every_5, 
           farmworker_vs_not) %>% 
  summarize(num_deaths = n_distinct(id),
            .groups = "drop")
  
df_ca_people_direct = df_ipums_direct %>% 
  mutate(age_cat_every_5 = case_when(
                             age < 30 ~ "1. 25 - 29",
                             age <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",
                             age <= 39 ~ "3. 35 - 39",
                             age <= 44 ~ "4. 40 - 44",
                             age <= 49 ~ "5. 45 - 49",
                             age <= 54 ~ "6. 50 - 54",
                             age <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
                             age <= 64 ~ "8. 60 - 64",
                             is.na(age) ~ "9. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE"),
        pre_post_covid = if_else(year < 2020, '1. Pre-Covid', '2. Post-Covid')) %>% 
  group_by(year,
           age_cat_every_5,
           farmworker_vs_not) %>% 
  summarize(num_people = sum(perwt),
            .groups = "drop")
  
df_direct_age = df_deaths_direct %>% 
  left_join(df_ca_people_direct,
            by = c("year" = "year",
                   "age_cat_every_5" = "age_cat_every_5",
                   "farmworker_vs_not" = "farmworker_vs_not")) %>% 
  left_join(df_census_2000,
            by = "age_cat_every_5") %>% 
  arrange(year,
          age_cat_every_5,
          farmworker_vs_not )
```

#### Age Adjusted Mortality Rates
```{r}
#| output: true
rate_expected = df_direct_age %>% 
  mutate(rate = num_deaths / num_people,
         expected_deaths_2000 = rate * population)
  
age_direct_overall_year = rate_expected %>% 
  group_by(year,
           farmworker_vs_not) %>% 
  summarize(n_expected = sum(expected_deaths_2000),
            n_observed = sum(num_deaths),
            n_population = sum(population),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(age_adjusted_mort_rate = round((n_expected / n_population) * 100000, 2)) 

  
age_direct_overall_year %>% 
  dt_table()
```

#### Age Adjusted Mortality Rates (Confidence Intervals)
```{r}
#| output: true
# using PHEindicatormethods package
# Calculate rates per country directly standardized for age and sex
mortality_ds_rate_phe <- df_direct_age %>%
     group_by(year,
              farmworker_vs_not) %>%
     PHEindicatormethods::phe_dsr(
          x = num_deaths,                 # column with observed number of events
          n = num_people,             # column with non-standard pops for each stratum
          stdpop = population,               # standard populations for each stratum
          stdpoptype = "field")       # either "vector" for a standalone vector or "field" meaning std populations are in the data  

# Print table
mortality_ds_rate_phe %>% 
  dt_table()
```


#### Excess Deaths per 100,000 by age group by year
```{r}
#| output: true
rate_expected %>% 
  mutate(rate = round(rate, 6)) %>% 
  group_by(year,
        age_cat_every_5) %>% 
  mutate(excess_expected_farmworker_deaths = expected_deaths_2000 - lead(expected_deaths_2000)) %>% 
  dt_table() %>% 
  add_commas(vars = c("num_deaths",
                      "num_people",
                      "population",
                      "expected_deaths_2000",
                      "excess_expected_farmworker_deaths"))
```





### Overall (Pre vs. Covid)

#### Age Adjusted Mortality Ratios
```{r}
df_census_2000 = read_csv(here::here("data/census_2000_age.csv")) %>% 
  filter(age >= 25 &
         age <= 64) %>% 
  mutate(age_cat_every_5 = case_when(
                             age < 30 ~ "1. 25 - 29",
                             age <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",
                             age <= 39 ~ "3. 35 - 39",
                             age <= 44 ~ "4. 40 - 44",
                             age <= 49 ~ "5. 45 - 49",
                             age <= 54 ~ "6. 50 - 54",
                             age <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
                             age <= 64 ~ "8. 60 - 64",
                             is.na(age) ~ "9. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE")) %>% 
  group_by(age_cat_every_5) %>% 
  summarize(population = sum(standard_population),
            .groups = "drop")
  
df_deaths_direct = df_cohort %>% 
  mutate(age_cat_every_5 = case_when(
                             recode_age_int < 30 ~ "1. 25 - 29",
                             recode_age_int <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",
                             recode_age_int <= 39 ~ "3. 35 - 39",
                             recode_age_int <= 44 ~ "4. 40 - 44",
                             recode_age_int <= 49 ~ "5. 45 - 49",
                             recode_age_int <= 54 ~ "6. 50 - 54",
                             recode_age_int <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
                             recode_age_int <= 64 ~ "8. 60 - 64",
                             is.na(recode_age_int) ~ "9. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE"),
        pre_post_covid = if_else(year.of.death < 2020, '1. Pre-Covid', '2. Covid')) %>% 
  group_by(pre_post_covid,
           age_cat_every_5, 
           farmworker_vs_not) %>% 
  summarize(num_deaths = n_distinct(id),
            .groups = "drop")
  
df_ca_people_direct = df_ipums_direct %>% 
  mutate(age_cat_every_5 = case_when(
                             age < 30 ~ "1. 25 - 29",
                             age <= 34 ~ "2. 30 - 34",
                             age <= 39 ~ "3. 35 - 39",
                             age <= 44 ~ "4. 40 - 44",
                             age <= 49 ~ "5. 45 - 49",
                             age <= 54 ~ "6. 50 - 54",
                             age <= 59 ~ "7. 55 - 59",
                             age <= 64 ~ "8. 60 - 64",
                             is.na(age) ~ "9. Unknown",
                             TRUE ~ "ISSUE"),
        pre_post_covid = if_else(year < 2020, '1. Pre-Covid', '2. Covid')) %>% 
  group_by(pre_post_covid,
           age_cat_every_5,
           farmworker_vs_not) %>% 
  summarize(num_people = sum(perwt),
            .groups = "drop")
  
df_direct_age = df_deaths_direct %>% 
  left_join(df_ca_people_direct,
            by = c("pre_post_covid" = "pre_post_covid",
                   "age_cat_every_5" = "age_cat_every_5",
                   "farmworker_vs_not" = "farmworker_vs_not")) %>% 
  left_join(df_census_2000,
            by = "age_cat_every_5") %>% 
  arrange(pre_post_covid,
          age_cat_every_5,
          farmworker_vs_not )
```

```{r}
#| output: true
rate_expected = df_direct_age %>% 
  mutate(rate = num_deaths / num_people,
         expected_deaths_2000 = rate * population)
  
age_direct_overall_year = rate_expected %>% 
  group_by(pre_post_covid,
           farmworker_vs_not) %>% 
  summarize(n_expected = sum(expected_deaths_2000),
            n_observed = sum(num_deaths),
            n_population = sum(population),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(age_adjusted_mort_rate = round((n_expected / n_population) * 100000, 2)) 

  
age_direct_overall_year %>% 
  dt_table()
```


#### Age Adjusted Mortality Ratios (Confidence Intervals)
```{r}
#| output: true
# using PHEindicatormethods package
# Calculate rates per country directly standardized for age and sex
mortality_ds_rate_phe <- df_direct_age %>%
     group_by(pre_post_covid,
              farmworker_vs_not) %>%
     PHEindicatormethods::phe_dsr(
          x = num_deaths,                 # column with observed number of events
          n = num_people,             # column with non-standard pops for each stratum
          stdpop = population,               # standard populations for each stratum
          stdpoptype = "field")       # either "vector" for a standalone vector or "field" meaning std populations are in the data  

# Print table
mortality_ds_rate_phe %>% 
  mutate(value = round(value, 2)) %>% 
  dt_table() %>% 
  add_commas(c("total_count",
             "total_pop"))
```

### Excess Deaths per 100,000 by age group by year
```{r}
#| output: true
df_excess_expected = rate_expected %>% 
  mutate(rate = round(rate, 6)) %>% 
  group_by(pre_post_covid,
           age_cat_every_5) %>% 
  mutate(excess_expected_farmworker_deaths = expected_deaths_2000 - lead(expected_deaths_2000))

df_excess_expected %>% 
  dt_table() %>% 
  add_commas(vars = c("num_deaths",
                      "num_people",
                      "population",
                      "expected_deaths_2000",
                      "excess_expected_farmworker_deaths"))
```

### Plot of Excess Expected Deaths by Age Group (Pre vs. Covid)
```{r}
#| output: true
#| out-width: 100%
df_excess_expected %>% 
  filter(!is.na(excess_expected_farmworker_deaths)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = age_cat_every_5,
             y = excess_expected_farmworker_deaths)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  facet_wrap(~pre_post_covid) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.95, hjust=1))
```
